text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
I'm... home.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Trainer... A drink for the King...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I'll give you... the special right
to pamper the utterly exhausted me. Come on... hurry up~..."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Gulp... haah...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, now I'm finally making my debut.
...Which means I can shine as a pro.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
“Remember, this is merely the very first step!
The King's journey is only just beginning!”
(*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Geez! What terrible timing for a phone call!
I was just about to say my big punchline—...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...It's Mother.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Once it's over, I'll chase after you.
(*clank*)
(Beep...)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —Good day.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, that's right.
I've debuted, is there a problem with that?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, it's true our generation is full of talent.
But even so, I—...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
It was nothing out of the ordinary.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Why debut at a time like this?"
"She's bound to get crushed in a generation full of powerhouse runners."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"You make snap judgments about everything."
"...Come back home before you embarrass yourself."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ‘By the time you despair over having no talent, it'll already be too late.’

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, I knew it, but still.
That person really doesn't get anything at all.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: There was really... nothing at all...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer. I've made up my mind!
Let's make a GⅠ our next goal!"

"Every race has its own grade,
a certain 'prestige' attached to it."

The classifications rise from Open, GIII, to GII,
with GI at the very top, but...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Winning a G1 is a given for a first-rate Umamusume.
Besides, if I'm doing it, I want both necessity and buzz.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: If we're planning ahead for next year's Classics, the standard move is to gain experience in medium-distance races rather than a 1600m mile.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: In that case, there's naturally only one choice: the race that crowns the Junior-class champion at year's end—the Hopeful Stakes.
Just as she said, the Hopeful Stakes is a 2,000m turf medium-distance race.

"The distance is close to the Classic races on the Triple Crown route,
so it should serve as valuable experience for the future."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Getting results there and claiming the Triple Crown wouldn't be half bad either.
Right, Trainer?
choice_data_list: This is going to be quite a journey.
This is going to be quite a journey.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It looks like the results will be so
wonderful that I have no choice but to admit it.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...And I'll show them. I'll show that person what I'm made of.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: There's no way... I don't have talent.

In contrast to her confident words,
her eyes were wavering.
